lepuycathedrale.name: Le Puy Cathedral
lepuycathedrale.slogan: Striped in volcanic stone, where the pilgrim road begins.
lepuycathedrale.line: Since the 10th century, Le Puy has been one of the starting points of the pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela.

aiguilhe.name: Saint-Michel d'Aiguilhe
aiguilhe.slogan: A tiny chapel balanced on a volcanic needle.
aiguilhe.line: 268 steps cut into the rock lead up to a chapel built on a plug where a Roman shrine to Mercury once stood.

pontdarc.name: Pont d'Arc
pontdarc.slogan: A river-carved stone arch at the gate of the Ardèche.
pontdarc.line: The arch formed between 108,000 and 138,000 years ago, so Chauvet Cave's painters already saw it standing.

stecitedudesign.name: Cité du Design
stecitedudesign.slogan: Rifles once came out of here; now it is chairs and posters.
stecitedudesign.line: In 2010 Saint-Étienne became the first French city named a UNESCO City of Design.

stepuitscouriot.name: Puits Couriot
stepuitscouriot.slogan: The headframe that still watches over coal country.
stepuitscouriot.line: Couriot was the last working shaft in Saint-Étienne, closed on 5 April 1973; the mining museum opened here in 1991.
